what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Morocco in Spain: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2190 Moroccan asylum seekers in Spain, 9.9% of all asylum seekers from Morocco.
Refugees from Morocco, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Spain and Italy.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Morocco, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 32 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 6355, at the end of 2021, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Spain only.
